lines: Supported Skills can only have one active Totem
Totems created by Supported Skills can splinter up to 2 times

Totems created by Supported Skills have 15% less
area of effect for each time they have splintered
Totems created by Supported Skills deal 15% less damage for each time they have splintered

Totems created by Supported Skills have 15% less maximum
Life for each time they have splintered
Totems created by Supported Skills have 7% less Skill Speed for each time they have splintered

Totems created by Supported Skills splinter after
performing 1 action
